name: bootstrap-success
description: Happy-path boot: the host reads `_meta.ui.resourceUri` and mounts the render resource. The view gets its `ai.ggui/render` slice (`runtimeUrl`, `sessionId`, `appId`, and a live trio `wsUrl` + `wsToken`) either inline on `globalThis.__GGUI_META__` (the per-render shell) or from the top-level `_meta` of the tool result the host forwards via `ui/notifications/tool-result` (the declaration-level shell). It loads the runtime bundle from `runtimeUrl`, the WS handshake succeeds, and the render mounts with `data-ggui-code-ready="true"`. No bootstrap-failed postMessage, no upgrade-required.
